text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono! My King, please listen! What 
an unbelievable turn of events...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I just bore witness to something entirely 
unacceptable!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, it's totally unacceptable. Anyway, 
this way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As soon as we arrived at the summer 
training lodge, Durandal came up to plead 
with me. Following behind her...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's do our best for our first 
training camp. Your body isn't fully 
conditioned yet, so don't overdo it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll do my best, step by step!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A trainer and a rookie Umamusume from 
somewhere are having a conversation, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
That Trainer... I know them. I saw them 
last year.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...seeing you at this training camp with 
another Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Such utterly outrageous and deplorable 
conduct...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Can something like this really be 
forgiven!? Coming here with a new 
Umamusume, of all things...
choice_data_list: I think that... should be allowed, though.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Why!? Is my King perhaps a follower of the 
Cheating-Is-Fine Sect!?
choice_data_list:
No, it's not cheating or anything like 
that!

No, it's not like I'm fooling around 
behind your back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Let me clarify. A Trainer contract is not 
permanent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Depending on the circumstances, it can be 
dissolved, and in cases like retirement, 
it has to be dissolved.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Cases where it gets dissolved too... No 
way...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King, in my case... that is simply 
impossible.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely out of the question. Pledging 
loyalty to another king, that is. 
Furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As if you would ever become infatuated 
with another Umamusume. If you ever did 
such a thing...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I will weep uncontrollably! Denounce you! 
And take the veil at a church! So please 
don't forget it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I have no plans or desire to 
cancel our contract. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They cannot stay together forever. That 
was a fate both Umamusume and Trainer 
usually chose to turn a blind eye to.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Dissolving is... also possible... But...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I... will not change... My... loyalty will 
not...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I dedicated my sword to the King... I 
shall live for the King's sake. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Will the day come... when I lose 
everything I've built up...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: The day I lose... this bond...
